strategy_ref: CLAUDE.md -> ## Current Strategy (2026-10-15 amendment); research + plan in docs/market-research-2026-10-15/
strategy_summary: AMENDED 2026-10-15: one personal profile, owned as Markdown, carried across every AI tool a heavy AI user runs (Claude Code, Codex, chat apps, and via their MCPs, video/image tools). Target widened from developers to anyone who works through CLI agents daily. Founder is the target user; validation is dogfooding, not outreach. Markdown-as-truth, no account, reviewable, Obsidian all kept from the 2026-07-31 line.

features.title: Land the new positioning in the harness and user-facing copy
features.description: The harness files written earlier on 2026-07-31 encode the now-reversed non-technical strategy. Until they are corrected they actively misdirect every future session.

context.files: CLAUDE.md (## Current Strategy rewritten, ## Common Mistakes updated), .claude/feature_list.json (this file), .claude/claude-progress.txt, pyproject.toml description, README.md + README.zh-CN.md positioning paragraphs
context.key_constraints: READMEs are 30KB/19KB -- change only the positioning paragraphs, do not rewrite them. CLAUDE.md must keep a one-line trace of the 5/25 -> 7/31 reversal so nobody re-proposes the non-technical line in three months.

acceptance_criteria: No file in the repo still asserts the non-technical beachhead as current
Positioning is consistent across CLAUDE.md, pyproject.toml, and both READMEs
The reversal and its reasoning are recorded in the append-only progress log

features.title: Index schema versioning + rebuild (BLOCKS all v0.3 features)
features.description: Hard blocker found during the 2026-07-31 code review. Indexer._init_schema() uses CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS, so adding a column is a silent no-op on any existing database. A codebase-wide grep found no rebuild, reindex, ALTER TABLE, or migration entry point anywhere. Every v0.3 feature below adds indexed fields, so all of them are blocked on this.

context.evidence: src/mneva/indexer.py:51 (_init_schema), src/mneva/indexer.py:89-100 (search filters in SQL before BM25 ranking). Closest thing to a rebuild is cli.py:255-257 inside sync-vault, which is tied to the vault flow.
context.approach: Add an explicit schema version to Indexer plus rebuild() that repopulates from store.iter_records() (store.py:85, already exists). Expose it as a new `mneva reindex` command.
context.key_constraints: This also closes a real gap: CLAUDE.md architecture rule 1 says SQLite is rebuildable from Markdown, which is currently NOT true in code.
context.outcome: Indexer now carries PRAGMA user_version (_SCHEMA_VERSION=1); an older-version DB is rebuilt from store.iter_records() on open. Added Indexer.rebuild() and the `mneva reindex` command. 4 new tests, incl. a regression guard verified to fail against the old code (asserted 1 == 2).

acceptance_criteria: Opening an old-schema sqlite DB with the new Indexer triggers migration or rebuild, never a silent failure
`mneva reindex` rebuilds from Markdown; after deleting the DB, status() count equals the number of store/*.md files
Reading an old .md file that lacks the new frontmatter fields still works

features.title: Design all three Record field groups in one pass
features.description: Features 1, 2, and 3 each add fields to Record. Designing them together avoids repeating the Record + to_dict() + frontmatter + index column + migration work three times.

context.field_groups: git provenance (repo_path, branch, commit_sha, dirty, changed_files) | staleness (last_verified_at, stale_after, supersedes) | review state (status: draft/permanent)
context.single_point: src/mneva/store.py Record dataclass and to_dict() -- the only serialization point (CLAUDE.md architecture rule 3); MCP and the HTTP API both go through it.
context.backward_compat: read_record must tolerate missing fields. Copy the existing optional-read pattern for `source` at store.py:66.
context.DECIDED_2026_07_31_git_fields: Store ONLY stable git provenance: repo_path, branch, commit_sha. DROP `dirty` and `changed_files` -- both are volatile (stale the moment they are written), and changed_files can be long enough to bloat frontmatter, which directly undercuts the Obsidian-readability selling point of the new positioning. commit_sha already answers 'which code state did this memory correspond to'; recompute diffs from git when needed.
context.REVISIT_batching_rationale: This entry originally argued for batching all three field groups into one schema change because migrations were expensive. p1-0 made migrations cheap (bump _SCHEMA_VERSION, rebuild() handles the rest), and every bump lands inside unreleased v0.3 so users only ever see one rescan. Prefer adding each field group WITH the feature that uses it, rather than landing unused columns ahead of their logic.
context.naming_note: For p1-3, do NOT name the review field `status` with a `permanent` value -- `lifespan` already uses `permanent` and the two would be confused. Use `review: draft|approved`, defaulting to `approved` so pre-existing records are not all hidden from search.
context.outcome: Only the git provenance group landed, per the revised rationale. Staleness and review-state fields will come with p1-2 / p1-3.

acceptance_criteria: One Record change covering all three groups, not three separate migrations

features.title: Git-aware metadata -- the strongest differentiator
features.description: memmy's memory is one global personal SQLite. mneva's memory can follow the repo and branch. This is the structural advantage; build it first.

context.behavior: capture records git provenance automatically; search/replay default to filtering by current repo + branch
context.files: new src/mneva/gitctx.py (extraction, must degrade gracefully outside a git repo), src/mneva/indexer.py (columns + search WHERE), src/mneva/cli.py, src/mneva/mcp_server.py, src/mneva/api.py (builds an Indexer in four places, api.py:52-90)
context.key_constraints: Filter in the SQL WHERE clause, never after retrieval -- post-filtering breaks top_k.
context.outcome: Fields: repo (normalized remote URL, the filter key) + repo_path + branch + commit_sha. New src/mneva/gitctx.py. Filter is `repo = ? OR repo IS NULL` so pre-v0.3 and non-repo records stay visible. CLI --repo/--all-repos/--no-git; MCP tools take repo_path; status reports provenance coverage. 206 passed (+27). Three guards verified discriminating by reintroducing each bug.
context.also_fixed: store.py and vault.py kept separate hardcoded frontmatter field lists -- the vault round trip (capture -> Obsidian -> sync-vault) would have ERASED provenance from the canonical record. Both now share store.record_frontmatter / record_from_frontmatter.

acceptance_criteria: Capturing inside a git repo records repo/branch/commit/dirty state
Capturing outside a git repo still works
search/replay scope to the current repo+branch by default and can be overridden

features.title: Dogfood: founder uses one mneva profile across Claude Code, Codex and a video MCP for two weeks
features.description: Validation for the 2026-10-15 direction. The founder is the target user, so validation is real daily use, not outreach. Hand-write the first profile Markdown before any new code so the format is shaped by real use.

context.demo: In Claude Code: 'make a 15s video for my product' via Runway or Higgsfield MCP, brand/audience/style read from mneva, nothing re-explained.
context.baselines_to_beat: (1) one Markdown file symlinked into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md; (2) memmy, which already imports Claude Code/Codex history but stores memory in a 40-table SQLite the user cannot read.
context.progress_2026_10_16: Phase A built. Profile draft v0.1 generated from 413 Claude Code prompts (2026-09-14..10-16) awaiting founder review; NOT yet captured into the real store. mneva MCP registered in Claude Code (user scope). Re-explain log not started.

acceptance_criteria: A re-explain log is kept for 14 days: each time background had to be restated to an AI tool, one line
Re-explain count in week 2 is clearly below week 1
At least one real video task completed end to end with zero background restated
Kill condition: if after 14 days the symlinked-file baseline is just as good, stop the expansion and return to the 7/31 engineer line

features.title: Draft / review / promote
features.description: Agent writes land as draft; the user approves before anything becomes permanent truth. Fits the reviewable positioning and was the core ask in the 5/25 research.

context.files: src/mneva/cli.py (new `mneva review` / `mneva promote`), src/mneva/mcp_server.py (capture_memory defaults to draft), src/mneva/indexer.py (drafts excluded from search by default)
context.note_2026_10_15: Moved to the front: auto-extracted profile entries must land as drafts and be approved before agents read them. No longer blocked on p1-2. Field naming decided in p1-05 still applies (review: draft|approved, default approved).

acceptance_criteria: MCP capture_memory writes draft by default
Drafts do not appear in default search results
review/promote/reject round-trip works from the CLI

features.title: Import memories back from Claude Code history and official chat exports (ChatGPT first, then Claude)
features.description: Return path of 'switch all memory to any tool': memories formed inside other tools flow back by importing their official exports. Order: Claude Code local history, ChatGPT export ZIP (tree-structured JSON mapping), Claude export. Doubao and Gemini export formats are unverified.

context.key_constraints: Local files only, no upload. Every imported entry lands as review: draft. Session file locations and formats must be verified on disk, not assumed.
context.note_2026_10_16: Founder's tools: Claude web+app, ChatGPT web, Doubao web, Gemini app, Claude Code, Runway, ChatCut, Seedance. Phase D in docs/market-research-2026-10-15/next-step-plan.md.

acceptance_criteria: Import never writes an approved record
Re-running import does not duplicate entries

features.title: Profile records: who I am, preferences, brand/style, ongoing work
features.description: A way to mark records as part of the personal profile, distinct from repo-scoped memories. Whether this is a new kind or a lifespan value is decided in design review.

context.key_constraints: Profile records have no repo (repo IS NULL), so they stay visible from every repository under the existing filter.

acceptance_criteria: Profile records round-trip through Markdown, vault sync and reindex

features.title: get_profile(task) MCP tool + `mneva brief --target <tool>`
features.description: Task-sized slice of memory. --target applies each paste-only tool's length limit and format (Doubao, Gemini import-memory, ChatCut, Runway web) and copies to clipboard. Phase A: this alone covers every tool on the founder's list at summary level.

context.progress_2026_10_16: `mneva brief` shipped (src/mneva/brief.py): --max-chars (default 4000), --scope, --copy. --target dropped: only ChatGPT's 1500 limit is known; inventing per-vendor limits would be fabrication. get_profile(task) MCP tool still pending (phase B).
context.known_gap: Records come out in id order (random hash), so under a tight budget WHICH sections survive is arbitrary. Needs an order/priority field, decide in p1-profile-kind.

acceptance_criteria: Output respects a token budget
Only approved records are returned
MCP result carries a human-readable summary key

features.title: `mneva setup`: one command after pip install
features.description: Founder chose path A on 2026-10-16: make mneva usable right after install for people who already use Claude Code / Codex. setup initializes ~/.mneva, registers the MCP server with every installed agent CLI, writes a profile template, and prints next steps. Ships in v0.3.0.

context.files: src/mneva/setup.py (new), one add_command line in src/mneva/cli.py (already over 500 lines, must not grow)
context.existing_pattern: src/mneva/upgrade.py: pure planning function + thin command; detect_install_method() picks the server argv
context.key_constraints: Find CLIs with shutil.which and pass the full path (Windows CreateProcess does not resolve .cmd). Idempotency by exit code of `claude mcp get mneva` / `codex mcp get mneva`, never by parsing output. uvx installs register `uvx --from mneva mneva-mcp` (Common Mistake #2). Never write into ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md here: that is p1-emit-agent-instructions.

acceptance_criteria: Registers mneva with Claude Code (user scope) and Codex when their CLIs are on PATH; skips missing ones with a message
Running setup twice changes nothing the second time
--dry-run prints the commands and changes nothing (only the read-only `mcp get` checks run)
Writes ~/.mneva/profile-template.md only if absent
A failing client registration is reported and does not stop the other client

features.title: Maintain a managed profile block in CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md
features.description: Covers the symlink baseline: agents that read instruction files get the profile without MCP.

context.key_constraints: Touch only the text between mneva's own begin/end markers; never rewrite the rest of the user's file. Opt-in.

acceptance_criteria: Content outside the markers is byte-identical after emit
Running emit twice is a no-op

features.title: Remote MCP endpoint for Claude web/app and ChatGPT via a user-run tunnel
features.description: Claude.ai custom connectors and ChatGPT developer-mode connectors only accept a public HTTPS MCP URL. Serve MCP over streamable HTTP locally, require a token, and let the user expose it with their own tunnel (cloudflared or similar). No mneva-hosted relay, so still no account.

context.key_constraints: Exposes personal memory on the public internet while the tunnel runs: auth is mandatory, default off, run gstack /cso before shipping. ChatGPT Plus connectors may be read-only; reading memory is enough, write-back comes from p1-history-import. Claude Free allows one custom connector. Copy must say 'no mneva cloud, no account', not 'zero cloud'.

acceptance_criteria: Endpoint refuses requests without the token
Claude web and ChatGPT can both call get_profile through the tunnel
Nothing listens on a public interface unless the user starts it explicitly

features.title: Stale / supersede
features.description: Every competitor talks about memory going stale, but mneva has git and can tell precisely what changed. That is the version nobody else can build.

context.key_constraints: On conflict, surface it -- do NOT auto-merge. Explicitly required by the research doc. Stale records get down-ranked or flagged at retrieval (indexer.py).
context.note_2026_10_15: Demoted: profile entries are curated by review, so staleness matters less than for repo memories.

acceptance_criteria: A memory whose commit context has moved on is detectable
Conflicts prompt rather than silently merging

features.title: Obsidian presentation -- the best demo of the whole pivot
features.description: The new positioning leads with Obsidian, and _mirror_to_vault_if_configured (cli.py:111) mirrors records into the vault. New frontmatter fields flow there automatically; design how they look deliberately rather than discovering it later.

context.why: Git provenance visible inside Obsidian -- which repo, which branch, which commit, whether it is stale -- is the most direct demonstration of Markdown-as-truth.
context.note_2026_07_31: Field *preservation* through the vault round trip is already done in p1-1. What remains here is presentation quality only -- how the frontmatter reads in Obsidian.

acceptance_criteria: Capture a memory with git provenance, open the vault in real Obsidian, frontmatter is readable and looks intentional

features.title: Token-budgeted replay
features.description: --budget 500|1000|3000|full. No full-context dump by default; rank by relevance + freshness + lifespan.

context.files: src/mneva/replay.py (79 lines, currently the simplest module), src/mneva/cli.py replay command
context.key_constraints: Weakest differentiator (everyone is building this), so it goes last -- but it is the direct answer to the highest-frequency complaint, context bloat.
context.note_2026_10_15: Becomes the mechanism behind p1-brief (task-sized profile brief). Build it as part of that entry.

acceptance_criteria: replay respects the budget and degrades gracefully when memories exceed it

features.title: Evidence assets
features.description: dogfood demo (use mneva to build mneva, show the memory files), token savings comparison (budgeted replay vs full injection), and the hygiene CLI (`mneva stale`, `mneva audit`).

features.title: Non-technical beachhead: validation experiment, landing page, usability
features.description: Cancelled by the 2026-07-31 strategy reversal. Covers the former p0a-rebuild-validation-experiment, p0a-landing-page, and p1-nontechnical-usability entries.

context.why: memmy-agent already shipped a better version of this plan (desktop app, free credits, one-click install, automatic history import). Competing head-on against a funded team with distribution, while mneva has not even solved installation, is a losing position.
context.important: This is NOT 'non-technical demand was falsified'. The 0/5 outreach had no statistical power; that question still has zero evidence either way. The cancellation is about competitive position, not demand.
context.revival_condition: Only if the competitive landscape changes materially.
